Islamabad Traffic Police has issued a traffic advisory regarding the movement of cricket teams in the federal capital. Diversions will be placed at different times on Club Road, Murree Road, Express Highway and Srinagar Highway, which may affect traffic flow.
Citizens are advised to leave 20–25 minutes earlier than usual and use alternate routes or service roads during diversion timings.

#Islamabad #IslamabadTrafficPolice @ICT_Police
